mapper.select: SELECT code,name,description,enabled,revision FROM nw_foundation_features ORDER BY code
SELECT code,name,description,enabled,revision FROM nw_foundation_features WHERE code=#{code} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_features(code,name,description,enabled,created_by,updated_by) VALUES(#{command.code},#{command.name},#{command.description},#{command.enabled},#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_features SET name=#{command.name},description=#{command.description},enabled=#{command.enabled},revision=revision+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE code=#{command.code} AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS text),plan_code,display_name,is_active,foundation_quota_revision FROM nw_billing_plans ORDER BY plan_code
SELECT CAST(id AS text),plan_code,display_name,is_active,foundation_quota_revision FROM nw_billing_plans WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) FOR UPDATE
SELECT feature_code,enabled,revision FROM nw_foundation_plan_features WHERE plan_id=CAST(#{plan} AS bigint) ORDER BY feature_code
SELECT feature_code,enabled,revision FROM nw_foundation_tenant_features WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) ORDER BY feature_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_plan_features(plan_id,feature_code,enabled,updated_by) VALUES(CAST(#{command.planId} AS bigint),#{command.featureCode},#{command.enabled},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_plan_features SET enabled=#{command.enabled},revision=revision+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE plan_id=CAST(#{command.planId} AS bigint) AND feature_code=#{command.featureCode} AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_tenant_features(tenant_id,feature_code,enabled,updated_by) VALUES(CAST(#{command.tenantId} AS bigint),#{command.featureCode},#{command.enabled},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_tenant_features SET enabled=#{command.enabled},revision=revision+1,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{command.tenantId} AS bigint) AND feature_code=#{command.featureCode} AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_foundation_tenant_features WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{command.tenantId} AS bigint) AND feature_code=#{command.featureCode} AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
mapper.sql: t.status IN('active','warning') AND p.is_active AND f.enabled AND COALESCE(o.enabled,g.enabled,false)

FROM nw_tenants t JOIN nw_billing_plans p ON p.id=t.plan_id CROSS JOIN nw_foundation_features f LEFT JOIN nw_foundation_plan_features g ON g.plan_id=p.id AND g.feature_code=f.code LEFT JOIN nw_foundation_tenant_features o ON o.tenant_id=t.id AND o.feature_code=f.code
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 WHERE t.id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND f.code=#{code} AND )
SELECT f.code WHERE t.id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND ORDER BY f.code
mapper.sql: CAST(t.id AS text) AS tenant_id,CAST(p.id AS text) AS plan_id,t.status AS tenant_status,p.is_active AS plan_enabled,COALESCE(t.override_quota_max_agents,p.quota_max_agents) AS agents,COALESCE(t.override_quota_max_workflows,p.quota_max_workflows) AS workflows,COALESCE(t.override_quota_max_knowledge_bases,p.quota_max_knowledge_bases) AS knowledge_bases,COALESCE(t.override_quota_max_members,p.quota_max_members) AS members,COALESCE(t.override_quota_max_channels,p.quota_max_channels) AS channels,COALESCE(t.override_quota_file_bytes,p.quota_file_bytes) AS file_bytes,COALESCE(t.override_quota_max_admin_tasks,p.quota_max_admin_tasks) AS admin_tasks,COALESCE(t.override_quota_max_sub_institutions,p.quota_max_sub_institutions) AS sub_institutions,t.foundation_quota_revision AS revision
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_tenants t JOIN nw_billing_plans p ON p.id=t.plan_id WHERE t.id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) FOR UPDATE OF t,p
SELECT FROM nw_tenants t JOIN nw_billing_plans p ON p.id=t.plan_id WHERE t.id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)

SELECT CAST(id AS text),quota_max_agents,quota_max_workflows,quota_max_knowledge_bases,quota_max_members,quota_max_channels,CAST(quota_file_bytes AS text),quota_max_admin_tasks,quota_max_sub_institutions FROM nw_billing_plans WHERE id=CAST(#{plan} AS bigint)

SELECT CAST(id AS text),override_quota_max_agents,override_quota_max_workflows,override_quota_max_knowledge_bases,override_quota_max_members,override_quota_max_channels,CAST(override_quota_file_bytes AS text),override_quota_max_admin_tasks,override_quota_max_sub_institutions FROM nw_tenants WHERE id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_billing_plans SET quota_max_agents=#{command.limits.agents},quota_max_workflows=#{command.limits.workflows},quota_max_knowledge_bases=#{command.limits.knowledgeBases},quota_max_members=#{command.limits.members},quota_max_channels=#{command.limits.channels},quota_file_bytes=CAST(#{command.limits.fileBytes} AS bigint),quota_max_admin_tasks=#{command.limits.adminTasks},quota_max_sub_institutions=#{command.limits.subInstitutions},foundation_quota_revision=foundation_quota_revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=CAST(#{command.planId} AS bigint) AND foundation_quota_revision=#{command.expectedRevision}

UPDATE nw_tenants SET override_quota_max_agents=#{command.limits.agents},override_quota_max_workflows=#{command.limits.workflows},override_quota_max_knowledge_bases=#{command.limits.knowledgeBases},override_quota_max_members=#{command.limits.members},override_quota_max_channels=#{command.limits.channels},override_quota_file_bytes=CAST(#{command.limits.fileBytes} AS bigint),override_quota_max_admin_tasks=#{command.limits.adminTasks},override_quota_max_sub_institutions=#{command.limits.subInstitutions},foundation_quota_revision=foundation_quota_revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=CAST(#{command.tenantId} AS bigint) AND foundation_quota_revision=#{command.expectedRevision}

choose.when: SELECT count(*) FROM nw_agents WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions wt WHERE wt.tenant_id=nw_agents.tenant_id AND wt.agent_id=nw_agents.id)

SELECT count(*) FROM nw_workflow_containers WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_workflow_test_sessions wt WHERE wt.tenant_id=nw_workflow_containers.tenant_id AND wt.container_id=nw_workflow_containers.id)
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_knowledge_bases WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_tenant_members WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_channels WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
SELECT COALESCE(sum(size_bytes),0)::bigint FROM nw_foundation_files WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND state IN('ready','deleting')
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_foundation_admin_jobs WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND state IN('queued','running','cancel_requested')
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_tenants WHERE parent_tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
